title: Student ID
description: Student identity credential carrying SCHAC and eduPerson attributes, issued as an SD-JWT VC. Multi-valued eduPerson and SCHAC attributes are arrays.

vct.description: Verifiable Credential Type identifier of the student ID.

identifier.description: Unique student identifier, such as an institutional student number or equivalent.

schacPersonalUniqueCode.description: Unique code associated with the student.

schacPersonalUniqueID.description: One or more unique identifiers for the student.

schacHomeOrganization.description: Home organisation or institution domain or identifier.

displayName.description: Display name formatted for user interfaces.

dateOfBirth.description: Student date of birth, as an ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD). SHALL NOT be in the future.

eduPersonPrincipalName.description: Principal name of the student, often expressed in user@realm format.

eduPersonPrimaryAffiliation.description: Primary affiliation of the subject with the educational organisation; the value SHOULD be 'student' unless the issuer has a specific student-equivalent category.

eduPersonAffiliation.description: One or more affiliations, such as 'student', 'member' or 'affiliate'. SHOULD include the value of eduPersonPrimaryAffiliation.

eduPersonScopedAffiliation.description: One or more scoped affiliation values, commonly 'affiliation@scope'. The scope SHOULD be consistent with schacHomeOrganization.

eduPersonAssurance.description: One or more assurance values (URIs or issuer-defined) for the subject or attributes.

iss.description: Issuer of the attestation, as an HTTPS URL that identifies the issuer.

iat.description: Time of issuance as a NumericDate (seconds since the Unix epoch).

nbf.description: Time before which the attestation is not valid, as a NumericDate.

exp.description: Time at which the attestation expires, as a NumericDate.

cnf.description: Confirmation claim that binds the attestation to the key of the holder (RFC 7800).

jwk.description: Public key of the holder as a JWK.

status.description: Reference to the Token Status List entry that carries the revocation status of the attestation.

idx.description: Index of the attestation in the status list.

uri.description: URI of the status list token.

jti.description: Unique identifier of the credential instance.

cryptographically_bound_to.description: Identifier of another attestation type to which this attestation is cryptographically bound, where such binding is used.
